knowledge.name: Fixed Synthetic Feedback Snapshot
knowledge.detail: Six fictional entries provide stable channels, categories, sentiment, scores, excerpts, dates, and synthetic ARR context.

knowledge.name: Feature Request and NPS Evidence
knowledge.detail: Six fixed requests provide votes, ARR weights, effort, review status, and linked feedback alongside two quarterly NPS snapshots.

knowledge.name: Product Review Rules and Anchors
knowledge.detail: Two uploaded knowledge files define evidence IDs, review labels, locked demo anchors, prohibited inferences, and human gates.

intelligence_processing.name: Cross-Channel Feedback Aggregation
intelligence_processing.detail: Summarizes synthetic volume, sentiment, categories, channels, average score, and represented ARR for product-team review.

intelligence_processing.name: Feature-Request Evidence Ranking
intelligence_processing.detail: Ranks fixed requests by supplied ARR weight and presents votes, effort, and review status without creating delivery priority.

intelligence_processing.name: Sentiment and NPS Synthesis
intelligence_processing.detail: Calculates positive and negative shares, presents fictional excerpts, and compares the two bundled quarterly NPS snapshots.

intelligence_processing.name: Roadmap Tradeoff Framing
intelligence_processing.detail: Computes a transparent synthetic impact score and frames validation questions without sequencing work or committing a roadmap.

clients_user_interface.name: Portable Brainstem Chat
clients_user_interface.detail: Runs ProductFeedbackSynthesizerAgent through local Brainstem chat and UI endpoints using bundled synthetic records.

clients_user_interface.name: Copilot Studio Draft Experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Provides natural-language access through a validated Draft agent with four behaviors and two synthetic knowledge files.

clients_user_interface.name: Cross-Functional Product Review
clients_user_interface.detail: Supports product managers, engineering leads, and product directors preparing evidence for product-trio and Teams review.

management_reporting.name: Product Feedback Summary
management_reporting.detail: Reports entry totals, average score, synthetic ARR context, and sentiment, category, and channel distributions.

management_reporting.name: Feature Request Review
management_reporting.detail: Reports review candidates by fixed ARR weight with votes, effort labels, and non-commitment statuses.

management_reporting.name: Sentiment and NPS Review
management_reporting.detail: Reports sentiment percentages, fictional customer excerpts, categories, scores, and the bundled quarterly NPS trend.

management_reporting.name: Roadmap Impact Assessment
management_reporting.detail: Presents synthetic impact rankings and review candidates while reserving prioritization and sequencing for product owners.

tools.name: Portable ProductFeedbackSynthesizerAgent
tools.detail: Single-file BasicAgent exposes four deterministic read-only operations with bundled synthetic data and no required credentials.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts the four-behavior conversational package; validated agents remain Draft and require explicit approval before publish.

tools.name: Deployment-Selected Foundation Model
tools.detail: The deployment environment supplies the model used for natural-language routing and evidence-first response generation.

tools.name: Synthetic Knowledge Package
tools.detail: Two uploaded files provide fixed records plus product-review rules for credential-free and reproducible demonstrations.

tools.name: Copilot Studio Skills and Behaviors
tools.detail: Four operation-specific skills and behaviors mirror the portable agent's feedback, request, sentiment, and impact paths.

tools.name: Dynamics 365 Feedback Seam
tools.detail: Named production source for approved customer context; the packaged solution has no live customer-system connection.

tools.name: Microsoft Teams Review Seam
tools.detail: Named collaboration surface for human product review; no notification, task, ticket, or customer action is configured.

supporting_features.name: Synthetic-Only Evidence Enforcement
supporting_features.detail: Forbids browsing, live retrieval, enrichment, substitution, or invention beyond the fixed feedback and request snapshot.

supporting_features.name: Four Deterministic Operations
supporting_features.detail: Routes feedback summary, feature-request ranking, sentiment analysis, and roadmap-impact requests from natural language.

supporting_features.name: Evidence-First Response Contract
supporting_features.detail: Requires stable IDs, supplied evidence, assumptions, conflicting signals, validation owners, and explicit synthetic labeling.

supporting_features.name: Product-Team Review Governance
supporting_features.detail: Product, engineering, design, security, support, and commercial owners retain prioritization and sequencing authority.

supporting_features.name: No External Mutation Boundary
supporting_features.detail: Prohibits roadmap commitments, Jira changes, backlog edits, team notifications, customer outreach, and account actions.

supporting_features.name: Inference Safety Boundary
supporting_features.detail: Prevents inferring churn, intent, or protected traits from sentiment, scores, ARR weights, votes, or a single excerpt.

supporting_features.name: Locked Demo and Draft Validation
supporting_features.detail: Maintains four passing persona cases with required evidence anchors while keeping Copilot Studio artifacts unpublished.
